descriptions.normal: A bread with a sauteed vegetarian filling. The cooked mixture is folded into rye dough, allowed to rise, and baked. It resembles a real mushroom so closely that, if not for the shallow cuts on its "cap," you'd almost mistake it for the real thing.
descriptions.suspicious: A bread with a sauteed vegetarian filling. After struggling through the charred crust, you finally get a taste, only to be hit with a muddy, earthy flavor. A few bites in, your head starts to spin... Could this be a new type of poisonous mushroom?
descriptions.delicious: A bread with a sauteed vegetarian filling. Its coarse, sturdy crust acts like a solid wall, sealing in the fragrant juices of the tender mushroom filling, creating a rustic yet satisfying taste that unfolds in your mouth.

effectTexts.normal: Revives a character and restores 1200 HP.
effectTexts.suspicious: Revives a character and restores 900 HP.
effectTexts.delicious: Revives a character and restores 1500 HP.
